verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator that lets users delegate bounded tasks to coding agents. Examples include `yylo init --task ... --subagent claude`, `yy pi 'Summarize this repository...'`, sessions resumable with `yy continue`, and fan-out and run-until-completion loops over kanban tasks, including tasks pulled from Slack or GitHub. However, the agents are external subagents and models that YYLO orchestrates, not clearly a native assistant built into the product. Missing for 10: evidence of a first-party built-in assistant (vs. wrapping external agents like Claude), any in-product conversational assistant surface, independent or hands-on corroboration of delegation quality.
